name: sidebar
description: A source-owned collapsible sidebar layout composition for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Unlike most registry items, upstream ships Sidebar as a styled preview component rather than an adico-primitives module; its only shared state is a plain open/closed signal from adico_primitives::use_controlled, and it composes the owned separator primitive directly. This initial pass renders one CSS-driven collapsible layout rather than upstream's document::eval-detected mobile sheet mode (that eval pattern was found non-functional while testing the Wave 3 overlay batch); a real viewport-driven mobile mode is deferred to M4/M5.
documentation.accessibility: `SidebarSeparator` composes `adico_primitives::separator::Separator` (`role="separator"`/`aria-orientation`, or `role="none"` when decorative); the rest of the composition is plain styled markup (`registry/ui/sidebar.rs`). No mobile/responsive viewport-driven collapse mode exists yet -- a named, deferred gap (see this file's own module doc).
documentation.keyboard: No dedicated keyboard-navigation layer of its own beyond native focus order through its composed buttons/links.
